home.title: Build a brand that holds — in conversation with George.
home.subtitle: Your brand consultant walks you through every decision: reasoned, scored and ready to ship — from purpose to monitoring.
home.beta: Branding Supply is in closed beta. You need an invitation code to start a branding.

team.title: We are our own proof.
team.intro1: We exist because good branding is too often either too expensive or reduced to a template. We believe every brand is a fingerprint — and the way there can be guided, reasoned and measured.
team.intro2: So we applied our products to ourselves first: the name, the fingerprint, this color world, this page — all of it was built with the Brand Wizard, our own Visual DNA and our own playbook. Graded by Ada, of course.
team.fingerprint: Branding Supply · The Sage · rest Creator — style: minimal · editorial — visual DNA: contemporary · geometric · monochrome + acid pop · spacious · digital-clean · precise
team.teamTitle: The right team member for every task.
team.teamIntro: We break your project into tasks — and each one is taken by the specialist who does it best. Seven roles, clear boundaries, one shared memory.
team.crewTitle: Inside the wizard, George does not work alone.
team.crewIntro: Every phase of your branding has its own interviewer — because the person who warms you up should not be the one who challenges your positioning. George leads and hands over.
team.ctaText: The team is ready — George asks the first question.
